paper_id: Li et al. - 2025 - Dissecting and Streamlining the Interactive Loop of Mobile Cloud Gaming
title: Dissecting and Streamlining the Interactive Loop of Mobile Cloud Gaming
motivation: MCG platforms exhibit high interactive latency (112-403ms) even under good network, critically affecting QoE for budget mobile users
problem_framing: Interactive latency is decomposed into 16 pipeline stages; VSync mechanism (5 events, 36% of latency) identified as root cause
key_insight: Game-irrelevant VSyncs (VSync2/3) are avoidable since MCG game monopolizes rendering pipeline, only appending system UIs to game frames
method_signature: LoopTailor: GFI intercepts frames to bypass cloud VSyncs; RVC predicts latencies and aligns remaining VSyncs across cloud-client
evaluation_criteria: Interactive latency reduction to <100ms (34% lower); latency fluctuation ratio reduced from 11.52 to 1.23
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: High-end devices with adaptive refresh rates make VSync5 optimization less effective; prediction error may cause frame deadline miss
evidence_for_taste: not every VSync event is functionally useful
a lack of coordination between the VSync events
network is not the key bottleneck
introducing non-trivial guest-host frame copy overheads
thinking_moves: 从系统测量出发逐阶段拆解pipeline,定位VSync为瓶颈
通过区分功能必要性与结构性必要性,识别可优化VSync
利用MCG独占渲染特性绕过通用图形同步约束
将云端渲染与客户端VSync解耦重组成协同调度问题
